visualCharacteristics.purpose: page-number navigation under an article listing

contentPattern.structure: page links (1, 2, ...) and optional first/previous/next/last links (text or «, ‹, ›, »), in one cell as a list or paragraphs, or one per row. An unlinked number is the current page

reuseGuidance: Use under a listing split across several authored pages. It does not page through a query index; each page is a separate authored page.
decisions: The source paginates a server-rendered listing; the block renders the authored links as a static nav.
